summary.name: teebe
summary.one_liner: A native macOS git worktree manager that shows which worktrees are being edited by coding agents, which have uncommitted changes, and which are merged and safe to delete.
use_cases: Track which git worktrees a coding agent is still working in
Review file changes an AI agent made before merging
Clean up merged worktrees and their branches safely
See which worktrees have uncommitted changes across several projects
Create and manage git worktrees without the command line
summary.what_it_does:
teebe is a native Swift macOS app that lists every git worktree in a project with a status mark: an animated orb while an agent works, an orange dot for uncommitted changes, a ring when commits are unmerged, and a green check when a worktree is merged and safe to delete. It shows a live file tree that updates as files are written, and Space opens a side-by-side inline git diff for a selected file. It can remove all merged worktrees and their branches after a confirmation list, re-checks each one before removal, and keeps commits only a removed worktree could reach under a hidden backup ref for 90 days. It also creates worktrees through a New Worktree sheet and can notify when a Claude Code or Codex turn finishes. The page says it reads git locally and does not edit files or run agents.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Native Swift macOS app, not Electron; reads git locally with no backend or analytics
Merge detection counts squash merges and checks against main, master, dev, develop and a chosen comparison branch
Detects worktrees created by claude --worktree, the Codex app, Cursor and plain git worktree add
Installable via Homebrew cask or install script; auto-updates via Sparkle
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or newer on Apple Silicon
Not notarized yet, so a downloaded .dmg needs manual approval in System Settings on first launch
Only Mac is supported according to the page
